name: mip-web
_comment_optionalDependencies: Linux native binaries, pinned so they reach the lockfile. package-lock.json is generated on Windows, and npm records only the host platform's optional binaries - so `npm ci` on a Linux CI or host installs none of these and the build dies on a missing .node file. The first symptom was 'Cannot find module ../lightningcss.linux-x64-gnu.node' on Vercel; @next/swc would have been next. Versions must match their win32 siblings exactly, so bump these together.
